# Emphasis Fixture

This line has *italic text*, **bold text**, and ***bold italic text***.

Underscore variants are also important: _italic_, __bold__, and ___bold italic___.

Preserve literal markers in cases like `**not bold in code**` and escaped emphasis \*not italic\*.

Common writing includes ~~strikethrough~~, ==highlight-like text==, and mixed 中文 **bold 中文** content.

Nested emphasis can appear as **bold with _italic inside_** and _italic with **bold inside**_.
